publications.title: Evolution of Humanoid Locomotion Control
publications.authors: Y. Gu, G. Shi, F. Shi, I. Chang, Y. Wang, Q. Cheng, Z. Olkin, I. Lopez-Sanchez, Y. Feng, J. Zhang, A. D. Ames, H. Su, and K. Sreenath
alts: Fig. 1 — Evolution of humanoid locomotion control across classical, learning-based, and emerging eras
Fig. 2 — Modeling landscape, from physics-based models to data-driven world models
Fig. 3 — Taxonomy of control methods and the deployment-time signal flow of each era
Fig. 4 — Classical control versus reinforcement learning pipelines
Fig. 5 — Emerging shifts: generative models, multimodality, multitask, loco-manipulation, test-time adaptation
publications.desc: A Science Robotics review tracing humanoid locomotion control through three eras — classical model-based control, learning-based control, and emerging foundation- and world-model approaches — and what each assumes about models, data, and the tasks a humanoid is expected to do.

publications.title: IRIS: Learning-Driven Task-Specific Cinema Robot Arm for Visuomotor Motion Control
publications.authors: Q. Cheng, M. Mackay and A. Bereyhi
publications.desc: IRIS is a low-cost 3D-printed 6-DOF cinema robot that uses goal-conditioned transformer-based imitation learning to autonomously generate smooth, object-aware camera motion.

publications.title: A Certifiably Correct Algorithm for Generalized Robot-World and Hand-Eye Calibration
publications.authors: E. Wise, P. Kaveti, Q. Cheng, W. Wang, H. Singh, J. Kelly, D. M. Rosen, and M. Giamou
publications.desc: Certifiably correct calibration achieving globally optimal robot-world and hand-eye alignment under general conditions.

publications.title: Master's Thesis: Design and Development of IRIS: An Intelligent Robotic Imaging System — A Low-Cost, 3D-Printed Cinema Robot Arm for Dynamic Shot Automation
publications.short: IRIS: A Low-Cost, 3D-Printed Cinema Robot Arm (M.Eng. Thesis)
alts: IRIS cinema robot arm thesis cover
publications.desc: Low-cost, fully 3D-printed 6-DoF cinema robot arm (IRIS) with FOC actuators, differential wrist, and a vision-conditioned imitation-learning stack in ROS.

publications.title: VibraForge: A Scalable Prototyping Toolkit For Creating Spatialized Vibrotactile Feedback Systems
publications.authors: B. Huang, S. Ren, Y. Luo, Q. Cheng, H. Cai, Y. Sang, M. Sousa, P. H. Dietz, and D. Wigdor
publications.desc: An open-source toolkit enabling rapid design and deployment of large-scale vibrotactile feedback systems for spatialized haptic interactions.

publications.title: AeroHaptix: A Wearable Vibrotactile Feedback System for Enhancing Collision Avoidance in UAV Teleoperation
publications.authors: B. Huang, Z. Wang, Q. Cheng, S. Ren, H. Cai, A. Alvarez Valdivia, K. Mahadevan, and D. Wigdor
publications.desc: Introduces a wearable vibrotactile system integrated with UAV teleoperation, leveraging control barrier functions for safe human-drone interaction.

publications.title: Extrinsic Calibration of 2D Millimetre-Wavelength Radar Pairs Using Ego-Velocity Estimates
publications.authors: Q. Cheng, E. Wise, and J. Kelly
publications.desc: Proposes a calibration framework for radar-radar pairs leveraging ego-motion cues without overlapping views for improved pose estimation accuracy.

publications.title: Spatiotemporal Calibration of 3D Millimetre-Wavelength Radar-Camera Pairs
publications.authors: E. Wise, Q. Cheng, and J. Kelly
publications.desc: Introduces continuous-time B-spline calibration for radar-camera systems, outperforming state-of-the-art methods in robustness and precision.

publications.title: Weakly Supervised Semantic and Attentive Data Mixing Augmentation for Fine-Grained Visual Categorization
publications.authors: M. He, Q. Cheng, and G. Qi
publications.desc: Proposes a weakly supervised attention-guided data augmentation strategy for fine-grained image classification tasks.

publications.title: Generative Design for Self-Balancing Unicycle Robot in Additive Manufacturing
publications.authors: J. Chen, Q. Cheng, and M. Han
alts: Generative design for a unicycle robot
publications.desc: Applies generative design and additive manufacturing techniques to develop a self-balancing unicycle robot prototype.

projects.title: MABEL: An Open Mobile Anthropomorphic Bimanual Robot
alts: MABEL, an open-source anthropomorphic mobile bimanual robot (paper Figure 1)
projects.desc: Open-source (MIT) whole-body robot: a 3-module holonomic swerve base, a 0.635 m lift with actuated torso, two 7-DOF arms, two 17-DOF ORCA hands, and a 3-DOF active head. 56 DOF from $8,722, with no machine shop. Teleoperated from Apple Vision Pro, iPhone, browser, or gamepad; full MuJoCo digital twin; demonstration-to-policy pipeline (ACT, Diffusion Policy, π0) deployed onboard. System paper under review.

projects.title: GeoDEX: Geometric Diffusion Transformers for Dexterous Manipulation
projects.short: GeoDEX: Diffusion Transformers for Dexterous Hands
projects.desc: Diffusion-transformer policy for 26-DOF dexterous pick-and-place. Maps dual-view RGBD and proprioception to action chunks with SE(3) geometric regularization. Includes Vision Pro-based human retargeting in MuJoCo.

projects.title: TINTIN: RL-Based Lunar Rocket Landing
projects.desc: 6-DoF variable-mass lander in MuJoCo with 2-DoF gimbaled thrust; PID baseline vs PPO policy; pose-targeted touchdown and fuel-efficiency metrics.

projects.title: Monocular Depth Estimation for Human-Robot Locomotion
projects.desc: Monocular depth pipeline for human-robot walking environments: ZoeDepth baseline, metric reprojection to 3D point clouds, and iterative RANSAC to extract stair planes and dimensions.

projects.title: CLEAR-Net: Cart-Pole Learning with Enhanced Adaptive Reinforcement Network
projects.desc: Compared tabular Q-learning, DQN, PPO, and SAC on noisy Cart-Pole; designed noise-robust wrappers, tuned hyperparameters, and analyzed robustness under disturbances and varying noise levels.

projects.title: Geometric Nonlinear Control for Biped Walking
alts: Biped walking on stairs with virtual holonomic constraints
projects.desc: Virtual Holonomic Constraints with polynomial gait design, feedback linearization, and terrain generalization to slopes and stairs.

projects.title: Localization for Aerospace Vehicles (IMU + Stereo)
projects.desc: Batch Gauss-Newton fusion with EKF; compared batch vs sliding-window estimators for trajectory accuracy.

projects.title: Mobile Robot Mechatronics Design Project
projects.desc: MATLAB, SolidWorks — Designed a 3D-printed Arduino-based mobile robot in Fusion 360; implemented localization and obstacle-avoidance for maze navigation in MATLAB; commanded the robot via Bluetooth.

projects.title: 8×8×8 LED Cube Embedded System
projects.desc: ESP32-based driver with SPI multiplexing; API control; interactive 3D Snake and Pong demos.

projects.title: Turtlebot2 SLAM, Navigation & Perception
projects.desc: Gmapping, frontier exploration, PID control; OpenCV perception and a CNN for 7-class emotion recognition.

projects.title: Electric Formula Racing Car Drive-train
projects.desc: Planetary gearbox quadrupling torque at >90% efficiency; kinematics, stress, thermal, and vibration analyses.
